notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.14)
notes.content: Fixed a problem in which skills activated by other players were not reflected under certain conditions during online multiplayer.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.13)
notes.content: Fixed an issue where only "VillagerX" were consuming medals when using skills in the training range.

notes.title: Changed and Fixed (Ver 1.0.12)
notes.content:
* Weakened enemies in single-player mode.

* Increased EXP for bosses and mid-bosses.

* Added some explanations to the settings screen.

* Fixed a problem in which a message "Not enough medal" would continuously appear when using a skill with insufficient medals when auto attack is enabled.
